tasks.title: Database Schema Migration
tasks.instructions: Write D1 compatible SQL to update `users` table adding `sybil_score` (INT), `auth_phase` (INT), `role` (TEXT). Create `audit_logs` table.

context_bundle.description: Requires D1 SQLite syntax. `users` table exists and needs `ALTER TABLE`. `audit_logs` should track user_id, action, ip_address, and timestamp.

tasks.title: Anti-Sybil Engine
tasks.instructions: Implement a 5-layer sybil scoring function checking: Turnstile bot score, IP velocity, disposable email domain, GitHub account age (>30 days), and GitHub activity (>5 repos or >20 contributions).

context_bundle.description: Export a single function `calculateSybilScore(user, req)`. Use TypeScript strictly without `any`. Leverage fetch for GitHub API checks.

tasks.title: Subdomain Routing
tasks.instructions: Implement routing based on `Host` header. `api.*` -> proxy hot path, `console.*` -> SPA static delivery, `admin.*` -> admin surveillance router (returns 404 for non-admins).

context_bundle.description: The entrypoint must parse `request.headers.get('host')`. Ensure zero cross-tenant state and strict isolation. Admin routing requires zero-knowledge denial.

tasks.title: Two-Phase Auth Tests
tasks.instructions: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests for the two-phase auth flow, sybil checks, and subdomain routing.

context_bundle.description: Target tests against worker router and sybil.ts. Must mock GitHub API responses and Turnstile checks.
